menu.name: EEP Options
menu.desc: Mod options, there aren't many to be honest

checkbox.name: Show FPS
checkbox.desc: Show the FPS counter (off by default)

checkbox.name: Hide Warning Screen
checkbox.desc: Skip the warning screen on startup (uncheck to see it again)

checkbox.name: Remove Ending Video
checkbox.desc: Skip the ending video completely instead of playing it

checkbox.name: Replace Death Screen
checkbox.desc: Use the new VHS tape death screen instead of the original

checkbox.name: CRT Curvature
checkbox.desc: Curve the screen like a CRT

checkbox.name: New VHS Filter
checkbox.desc: Use the new striped VHS filter
